Roger Masellas

UNDER CONSTRUCTION

My PDF resumé: CA / EN / ES

My LinkedIn profile: here

I've been building websites since 1996. I co-founded the design and multimedia studio Lamosca, where for 22 years I led first the multimedia and then the internet area, on projects for TV3, Sónar, CCCB, Mercat de les Flors and Barcelona City Council.

From 2018 to 2025 I was a frontend developer at A!CLARO: custom WordPress themes and plugins, around 200 landing pages for Veepee and Privalia, and the online shops of Laie, Sagrada Família and MNAC.

I'm now looking for a new team where I can coordinate web projects, develop or teach. Meanwhile, I keep working for the legal journal Indret and build my own projects with Claude Code, such as GrausFP, a search engine that brings together scattered public information on vocational training (FP).

I've also taught at Seeway and Elisava, and I'm qualified to teach in vocational training. Still learning, every day.
